1. (Currently Amended) A multi-layer coating comprising: (a) a color-imparting, non-hiding coating layer deposited from a protective coating composition comprising an aqueous dispersion comprising color-imparting particles stably dispersed in aqueous medium in admixture with one or more polymers, and (b) a clear coat layer deposited over at least a portion of the color-imparting, non-hiding layer, __wherein the color-imparting, non-hiding coating layer has a light transmittance of 10 to 95% at a wavelength of 400 to 700 nm in a 15-micron thick cured coating film__.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently Amended) The multi-layer coating of claim 1 in which the color-imparting particles are present in the aqueous dispersion in an amount of 0.1 to 50 percent by weight based on total solids present in the aqueous dispersion.

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Cancelled)

6. (Currently Amended) The multi-layer coating of claim 1 in which the one or more polymers contain __a functional group selected from the group consisting of carboxylic acid groups, epoxy groups, hydroxyl groups, isocyanate groups, amide groups, carbamate groups, and carboxylate groups, wherein said functional group is reactive with a curing agent__.

7. (Original) The multi-layer coating of claim 6 wherein the functional groups are selected from the group consisting of epoxy groups, carboxylic acid groups, hydroxyl groups, isocyanate groups, amide groups, carbamate groups, carboxylate groups and mixtures thereof.

8. (Currently Amended) The multi-layer coating of claim 6 in which the aqueous dispersion contains __an aminoplast curing agent and/or a polyisocyanate curing agent including blocked polyisocyanates__.

9. (Cancelled)

10. (Currently Amended) The multi-layer coating of claim 1 in which the one or more polymers are present in the aqueous dispersion in amounts of 10 to 70 percent by weight based on total weight of solids in the aqueous dispersion.

11. (Cancelled)

12. (Currently Amended) The multi-layer coating of claim 1 applied over a reflective surface comprising a reflective material __selected from metallic pigments including aluminum, bronze, or copper powders,__ having a total reflectance of at least 30 percent.

13. (Original) The multi-layer coating of claim 12 wherein the reflective material is a base coat deposited from a coating composition.

14. (Original) A substrate coated with the multi-layer coating of claim 1.

15. (Original) A substrate coated with the multi-layer coating of claim 13.

16. (Currently Amended) The multi-layer coating of claim 1 in which the one or more polymers are selected from __water-soluble or water-dispersible__ acrylic polymers, polyester polymers, polyurethane polymers, polyether polymers, including mixtures thereof.
